comment: Read automatically by depcheck, which update-npm-deps.ps1 runs at the end of every sweep to report declared
dependencies nothing appears to use. depcheck cannot see a package that is only invoked as a CLI from a script,
named as a string in a config, or pulled in by a compiler option, so each name below is a verified false positive
with the reference that proves it. Because this file exists, anything depcheck still reports fails the sweep -
so a genuinely unused dependency cannot be waved through, and a new entry here needs its reason recorded.
The key is `ignores`, depcheck's CLI-style rc name; `ignoreMatches` is the API-only spelling and is silently
ignored in this file.
@commitlint/cli - .husky/commit-msg runs it as the `commitlint` binary.
@commitlint/config-conventional - extended by name (a string in `extends`) by src/script-utils/commitlint-config.ts, never imported.
@types/babel__core - nothing here imports @babel/core, but svelte-preprocess's dist/types/options.d.ts does. tsconfig.json sets
skipLibCheck true, so the compile does not care - but buildCompileTypeScript()'s second pass re-checks with skipLibCheck false
(AGENTS.md, "Type Validation"), and without these types that pass gains a TS7016. Its `Ignored N diagnostic(s)` count is meant
to reach 0; dropping this raises N instead.
@types/pug - same second pass, same file: svelte-preprocess's options.d.ts imports `pug`, which is untyped without this.
@typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin - referenced by the `"@typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin": "$@typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin"`
overrides shorthand, which resolves its version against this declaration.
better-typescript-lib - has no import anywhere by design: it supplies the @typescript/lib-* aliases that tsconfig.json's
`libReplacement: true` resolves.
brace-expansion-upstream - the alias that installs the patched brace-expansion 5.x. Its only consumer is
patches/brace-expansion-callable/index.js, which depcheck does not scan as project source. See AGENTS.md, "Security overrides".
cspell - run as a CLI (`npx cspell`) by src/script-utils/linters/cspell.ts, configured by cspell.json.
czg - run as a CLI by scripts/commit.ts.
dprint - run as a CLI (`npx dprint`) by src/script-utils/formatters/dprint.ts, configured by dprint.json.
husky - installed by scripts/prepare.ts; the hooks in .husky/ are its output.
localforage - referenced only as `typeof import('localforage')` in src/obsidian/@types/dataview/data-import/persister.d.ts,
an import type depcheck's parser does not follow.
markdownlint-cli2 - run as a CLI (`npx markdownlint-cli2`) by src/script-utils/linters/markdownlint.ts, configured by
.markdownlint-cli2.mjs.
moment - never imported here, but node_modules/obsidian/obsidian.d.ts opens with `import * as Moment from 'moment'`, so the
package has to resolve for tsc. scripts/eslint-config.ts allow-lists it in `depend/ban-dependencies` for the same reason.
nano-staged - .husky/pre-commit runs it; configured by .nano-staged.mjs / src/script-utils/nano-staged-config.ts.
postcss-modules - nothing here imports it; esbuild-sass-plugin's lib/utils.d.ts does, and without it the skipLibCheck-false
re-check described under @types/babel__core reports a TS2307.
svelte-check - run as a CLI (`npx svelte-check`) by src/script-utils/build.ts.
typedoc-plugin-mdn-links - never imported; scripts/docs-gen/helpers/api-doc-link-rendering.ts reads
node_modules/typedoc-plugin-mdn-links/data/web-api.json at runtime for the MDN Web API link map.
